response:
I'm really sorry you're dealing with this—racing thoughts, poor sleep, and constant anxiety are exhausting, especially when medications haven't been an option for you. That's a lot to carry, and it makes sense you feel like a wreck.

Since medicines have caused hard reactions, it's worth asking your doctor about non-medication approaches, and mentioning your head injury history—sometimes anxiety and sleep issues after a head injury need a specialized evaluation (like a neurologist). In the meantime, some people find slow breathing helpful: breathe in for four counts, hold briefly, then exhale slowly for six. Gentle movement, limiting screens before bed, and grounding techniques (naming things you can see, hear, and touch) can also ease a racing mind.

You don't have to figure this out alone. If your anxiety ever feels unbearable or you have thoughts of harming yourself, please reach out to a crisis line (call or text 988 in the US) right away. You deserve real support and relief.
